jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Data Core (remote, Europe)
jobs.description:
Hey, I'm Andrei. I’m hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Core team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies (including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN) use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Every one of those products depends on fresh, reliable creator data. Data Core owns the systems that collect and maintain profiles for 400M+ creators across social platforms, process billions of data points, and keep the rest of Modash supplied with the raw material it needs.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Data Core isn't an internal support team. It owns the collection infrastructure that the entire Modash product (and every downstream data team) depends on.

Collecting social data at this scale is a hard distributed-systems problem. APIs change without warning. Providers become unreliable. Platforms rate-limit requests. Data grows stale. A tiny inefficiency becomes expensive when repeated hundreds of millions of times.

We need a senior engineer who can design resilient services, make thoughtful tradeoffs between coverage, freshness, reliability, and cost, and take production-critical systems from a rough idea to dependable operation.

You’ll join the specialised Data Core team and work closely with Data Search, Data Insights, product teams, and company leadership. You’ll have real ownership, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Keep creator data flowing at massive scale.

You’ll build and evolve the systems that collect and maintain 400M+ creator profiles across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, keeping billions of data points fresh enough for search, analytics, APIs, and customer-facing products.

2. Make collection resilient when the outside world isn't.

You’ll design services that handle third-party API instability, rate limits, provider outages, platform changes, and partial failures without turning every disruption into a customer incident.

3. Improve the economics of collection.

At this scale, every request, proxy call, retry, storage decision, and compute cycle matters. You’ll improve coverage and freshness while keeping the system financially sustainable.

4. Own production, not just the code.

You’ll shape the problem, design the architecture, write and review the code, ship it, observe it, and improve it. You’ll build the monitoring and operational safeguards that catch gaps and regressions before customers do.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A social platform has changed its behaviour overnight. Collection success has dropped, but only for part of the traffic. You trace the failure pattern, protect downstream freshness, and design a resilient fix rather than a brittle patch.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You redesign part of the subscription system that decides which creators to collect, when, and how often, balancing customer value against request and compute cost.
  • Wednesday. You pair with a Data Search engineer on an indexing dependency. Together, you agree on a cleaner contract that improves freshness without coupling the two teams’ systems.
  • Thursday. You review a new request-routing approach across proxy providers. You model throughput, failure modes, and unit economics before shipping a small production experiment.
  • Friday. An observability review reveals a slow coverage regression that existing alerts missed. You improve the data-quality checks so the team catches the next one before it reaches customers.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, harden, and operate systems.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale backend or data systems. You have solid experience with high-volume services where reliability, throughput, latency, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped systems from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, operation, and iteration, not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about partial failure, retries, idempotency, backpressure, scaling, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built resilient integrations. You’ve worked with third-party APIs or other external dependencies that are rate-limited, unstable, or liable to change.
  • Taken operational ownership. You care about observability, alerting, runbooks, and what happens after deployment, not just whether the code merged.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and make progress without waiting for a perfectly specified ticket.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain tradeoffs, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with social-media APIs, data-quality frameworks, large-scale collection systems, or freshness and coverage monitoring. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • TypeScript and Node.js as the primary languages
  • Aurora Limitless/Postgres for subscription and collection state
  • S3 for raw data-lake storage
  • CloudWatch for observability and alerting
  • Proxy networks and custom routing layers
  • ECS, SQS, Athena, and other AWS services
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 80,000€ - 110,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take production-critical infrastructure from idea to operation without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, Toronto
jobs.description:
Hi! I’m Steph, Head of Growth for Data Products at Modash.

I joined Modash to help grow a newer and increasingly important side of our business: our Data products.

Today, more than 100 companies using Modash data to power their own products and businesses. They’re building creator discovery tools, enriching their own datasets, powering workflows, and solving problems we probably haven't even thought of yet. And we're growing quickly.

A huge part of that growth isn't just finding new customers. It's helping the customers we already have build better products, get more value from our data, and grow with us.

That's where you come in.

Scope of the role & what you'll actually do

We currently have two Technical CSMs in Canada and one in Europe, and we're hiring another based in Toronto, Canada. Your job is simple to explain and hard to do well: help customers turn Modash data into successful products, and own the outcome when getting there gets messy.

You'll own the entire journey for our API customers: from onboarding and adoption to expansion and long-term growth. Doing this well means becoming an extension of their team: understanding what they're building, where they're going, and how Modash can help them get there.

1. Own your portfolio of accounts

You'll manage a portfolio of customers using one or both of our APIs. Success is measured mainly through Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and the work that drives it.

You'll:

  • Build clear success plans with goals, priorities and next steps
  • Run regular customer calls and proactively keep things moving
  • Understand what customers are building and help them use the right data and endpoints
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and own getting them resolved
  • Spot risks early and create a plan
  • Find new ways Modash can help customers grow
  • Own expansion end-to-end, from spotting the opportunity to closing the upgrade
  • Own renewals and keep your accounts organised and up to date

2. Onboard new customers

Once a customer buys Modash, you'll become one of their closest partners here.

You'll:

  • Run a strong Sales → CS handover
  • Understand what they're building and what success looks like
  • Create a clear integration plan with milestones and owners
  • Help them make the right technical decisions and remove blockers
  • Help them get to first value quickly
  • Leave every interaction with clear next steps, owners and dates

3. Collaborate across Modash

You'll be the voice of your customers internally.

You'll work closely with Product to bring them clear customer problems and opportunities, connect customers for discovery and testing, coordinate with Sales on expansion, work with Support and Engineering on technical issues, and help Marketing turn what we're learning into useful customer resources.

Even when other teams are involved, you own driving the customer outcome forward.

The tools you'll use:

  • Vitally → Customer Success CRM
  • Notion → internal knowledge
  • Intercom → customer communication and support
  • Stripe → subscriptions and invoices
  • FullStory → debugging and customer behaviour
  • Calendly → scheduling

Requirements

  • 2+ years in Technical Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role
  • Experience working with APIs or data products, or a background in a technical, product management or product owner role
  • Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations and data flows. You don't need to code, but you should be technically curious to understand.
  • You lead customers, rather than simply support them. You ask good questions, understand the real problem and help decide what happens next
  • You take ownership. When something gets messy, you simplify it, make a judgement and drive it to an outcome
  • You're a clear, concise communicator who can make complicated things simple
  • You're commercially minded and naturally look for ways customers can get more value and grow their business
  • You're proactive, organised and comfortable working without a perfect playbook
  • Strong written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with creator data or creator marketing
  • Experience owning renewals and expansion
  • Some coding or data experience, such as reading code, writing small scripts or SQL

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours. We trust you to manage your time.
  • Unlimited paid vacation. Take the time you need to rest and recharge.
  • Compensation. CAD ca 150,000 to 170,000 on-target earnings (OTE) per year + stock options.
  • Fully remote working. Work from wherever suits you. The team is based in Toronto and most customers are in North America.
  • Personal development. We'll support courses, books or conferences that help you grow.
  • Ownership. Data is an important growth area for Modash. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, try things and help shape how this part of the business grows.

A little bit more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

jobs.title: Web Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hey, I’m Avery, the CEO of Modash.

We’re working to help every creator earn a living. Nearly 3,000 brands around the world use Modash to discover, partner with and pay creators: from finding the right people to managing relationships, measuring campaigns and running affiliate programs.

I’m looking for a Web Product Manager to own the direction of our website and help more of the people who find Modash become customers.

Background & reason for hiring

Our website brings in millions of organic visitors each year. We have a strong foundation in SEO and content, talented people across design, marketing and engineering, and no shortage of ideas for what the website could do better.

But traffic alone isn’t enough. Today, that means:

  • Visitors arrive, but not enough of the right ones understand Modash and take the next step, whether that’s signing up or booking a demo.
  • Requests come from across the company, from both Platform and API, and nobody owns the call on what matters most for the website as a whole.
  • Without one owner, it’s hard for the team to prioritize and move as fast as it should.

The website serves our Platform, our API and teams across Modash. Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, SEO/AEO, Design and Engineering all contribute to it. I’m looking for someone who can treat the website like a product: build a vision for it, make choices based on evidence, and help a team turn those choices into results. This isn’t a job for someone who wants to manage a queue of requests without challenging them.

Scope of the role & some examples

Example 1: Giving the website a clear direction

  • Developing a vision and roadmap for web that supports both the Platform and API
  • Sitting with Platform and API stakeholders who both need website changes, understanding the business case for each, and deciding what the team should do first
  • Being clear about what waits or doesn’t get done, so people across Modash understand what the web team is working on and why

Example 2: Turning more of our traffic into customers

  • Looking at a high-traffic page that isn’t generating enough signups, working out why, and agreeing on an improvement with design and engineering
  • Working with Product Marketing on a page that makes a part of Modash easier to understand, then checking whether the change made a difference
  • Running experiments where useful and measuring the impact on signups, demo bookings and the quality of the customers we attract
  • Protecting the organic foundation that brings people to Modash in the first place

Example 3: Leading the people and work behind the website

  • Giving designers context and feedback on a problem without prescribing their solution, and trusting their expertise
  • Bringing marketing, product and engineering together to take work from an unclear problem through design, launch and learning
  • Reviewing how a page moves from brief to launch and fixing the parts of the process that slow people down
  • Working with technical partners on measurement and site quality, so we can move quickly without losing what makes the website effective

You won’t be writing every line of code or designing every page. But you’ll need to get close enough to the work to make good decisions and help the team move.

Team structure

You’ll work closely with designers and the people building the site, and partner with stakeholders across Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, SEO/AEO, Design and Engineering.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

  • You’ve owned a website or digital product with a clear business outcome. You can tell us what you changed, why you chose it and what happened.
  • You’ve improved a customer journey or conversion funnel using data, customer insight and experimentation.
  • You’ve set a direction and prioritized competing opportunities, including saying no when the team can’t do everything.
  • You’ve led or developed people and helped designers, engineers and marketers work well together. You give clear feedback and trust the specialists around you.
  • You’ve taken cross-functional work from an ambiguous problem through to launch and learning.
  • You’re comfortable with web analytics and the technical side of running a website. You don’t need to write the code, but you can have a useful conversation with the people who do.
  • You communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders with different goals.

Nice to haves:

  • B2B SaaS experience
  • Experience with organic acquisition
  • Experience with a website serving more than one product

More important than any of these is that you can understand our context, build a sensible plan and make it happen.

Benefits

What we’re offering

  • Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.
  • Compensation 💰 Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we’re growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 70,000€ - 90,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re happy and well rested, you’ll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.
  • Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there’s a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we’ll cover it.
  • Ownership 💡 You’re the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You’ll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.
  • Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.
